newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound falls against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound falls against the dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound fell against the dollar on Wednesday's private sector market despite some reports from bankers of liquidity in the U.S. currency.
"There are many dollars in the market today, maybe because of the treasury bill auction tomorrow," one banker said.
Five actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3920 and 3.3950 bid and 3.3945 and 3.3950 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average rate was 3.3931 bid and 3.3949 offered, compared with 3.3915 pounds bid and 3.393375 pounds offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.389541 pounds buy and 3.395697 pounds sell.
